title: Chronic Sucrose Intake, Markers of Health and Biomarker Identification
brief_summary: With free sugar intake proving to be of a concern within the general public, discovery and validation of a new biomarker will allow for more consistent measurement of sucrose intake. Furthermore, using a multi-omic approach the investigators will identify metabolic perturbations to the metabolome and proteome.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age 19-64, healthy diagnosis

Exclusion Criteria:

* gastrointestinal issues, doesn't consume sugar
